response.query: Which instruments (commodity-input shocks, JPY exchange moves, retailer disruptions) will we pre-register, what timing windows and exclusion restrictions apply, and how will we test relevance and overidentification?
response.answer: Commodity-input shocks, JPY exchange moves, and retailer disruptions will be pre-registered as instruments. Timing windows and exclusion restrictions will be specified in the pre-registration document. Relevance and overidentification will be tested using standard IV methods.
